annotations.title: Studio: approve or reject one of the user’s videos

description: The user’s own Aprovar / Reprovar on a finished video of their project (the buttons on aniamodels.shop/ania-studio). Rule of the account: only an APPROVED version may be used anywhere (posted, uploaded, sent); check `decisao` in studio_listar_projetos / studio_andamento before using a video. `decisao: "aprovar"` (optional `motivo` = comment of what to keep), `"reprovar"` (`motivo` required: why / what to redo) or `"desfazer"`. Default version = newest finished one. Only call it after the user said what to decide. Free.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

versao.description: Version number; omit for the newest finished one.
